answer: Proof-of-Stake acts as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism by mandating capital commitment within a secure vault. An attacker attempting to scale fake identities faces a cost proportional to the total staked value, ensuring the system avoids a performance nadir caused by spam. This economic barrier turns identity fabrication into an opal of rarity for malicious actors, as the sheer expense of acquiring enough network weight to influence consensus renders large-scale deception prohibitively costly.
